$comment: Default-deny licence policy (D-002). Anything not allowed here fails CI, including unknown licences. GPL and AGPL may never be allowlisted. Exceptions are version-specific and need a reviewed entry in docs/legal/exceptions.md.

devOnlyAllowed.MPL-2.0: Weak, file-level copyleft. Allowed only for build tooling that never ships in a Zilo bundle (today: lightningcss via Vite).
